A '''torpedo line''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] commanded by a [[Captain of the Line/Legends|captain of the line]]. It consisted of two [[Torpedo Sphere/Legends|Torpedo Spheres]].
